subject: Taxes
title: FATCA: America's Long Arm
description: One-minute skill: FATCA: America's Long Arm.

hook.text: In 2010, the US passed FATCA, forcing every bank in the world to report American account holders to the IRS.

buildup.text: FATCA requires foreign banks to identify US customers and send their account details to the IRS.

discovery.text: Over 300,000 foreign banks now comply with FATCA. The US reached into the world's banking system from Washington.

twist.text: The US demands transparency from foreign banks but doesn't reciprocate fully.

climax.text: FATCA proved one country can reshape global banking—if it's powerful enough. Might makes tax transparency.

punchline.text: 300,000 foreign banks report to the IRS. America's tax reach is global.

quiz.question: What does FATCA require foreign banks to do?
options: Report American account holders to the IRS
